'''Lloyd Zisla Turning to the Dark Side Pays Off''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lloyd Zisla]]
* '''Published:''' April 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Central Core|Premiere-D-deathstarcentralcore.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Turning to the Dark Side Pays Off
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Turning to the Dark Side Pays Off.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This is the deck I have compiled over about a year and a half of collecting and tinkering. It includes a lot of expensive and hard to get rare cards, and it has been fairly successful against other high-powered decks.

== Strategy ==

This deck has generally been able to win against both space and land based decks. When using it in space, deploy pilots directly to the Star Destroyers. If your opponent is concentrated on the ground, well AT-AT's can swiftly decimate your opponent by making your forces immune to attrition

It is a major pain in the arse (or so irrate enemies have told me) to have one's one fleet used against you. Put Lennox on the tyrant with a tractor beam and you will be able to steal unpiloted ships without even having to fight over them. If battle does occur, use ion cannons to make easy targets for the tractor beams, then use R5-A2 to make them spaceworthy again.
